input:
Earlier scenes:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

This scene:
别的人给了神农一个灵芝。这个植物可以让神农更好。比方说，他会觉得更健康。吃灵芝以后，他可以再走。现在他觉得更好。最后，神农找到了很多植物，他可以用对药。这些植物让神农很高兴。神农想跟很多人分享他的新药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 这个植物可以让神农更好：身体更好
- 比方说，他会觉得更健康：比方说is used to express “for example”, delete it
- 吃灵芝以后，他可以再走：吃了，了completed; 又可以走了

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：一个人给了神农一个灵芝，别的人 means people other than a previously identified person or group; no such contrast has been established here, so introduce this new person with 一个 人 instead. [teacher rule: bieren]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他可以用对药：可以用来做药，植物 can be used as medicine with 用来做药; 对药 is not a valid phrase for this meaning. [rule: word_choice]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这个植物：它，灵芝 was named in the immediately preceding sentence, so use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence rather than repeating a noun phrase. [rule: redundancy_delete]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这些植物让神农很高兴：这些植物让他很高兴，神农 was mentioned recently and there is no competing male character, so a pronoun is more natural. [rule: redundancy_delete]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农想跟很多人分享他的新药：他想跟很多人分享他的新药，continue with a pronoun when the same character remains the clear subject in the next sentence. [rule: redundancy_delete]

items.reason: 别的人 requires a contrast with other people, while 一个 introduces an unspecified new person correctly.
用对药 is not a valid expression here; 用来做药 correctly expresses using the plants to make medicine.
灵芝 was just mentioned, so it should be referred to as 它, but the remaining wording 让神农更好 is still incomplete in meaning.
神农 is the immediately established, unambiguous subject, so 他 is the appropriate close re-reference.
The same clearly identifiable character continues as subject, so 他 should replace the repeated name.
